description: Integer-N ring-oscillator PLL for the GF180MCU open PDK. This is the integrator view: what a full-chip integrator takes, as structured data (2am cross-cutting rule 9, 2AMLogic/2am REUSE.md §"Adopt or record"). Prose lives in README.md; consumer requirement rows live in spec/pll.md#consumers.

domains.note: VCO's own quiet domain (bias generator, band-select mirror, 5-stage ring, output buffer, on-chip decap); the block's supply-sensitive rail (spec/pll.md#supply-sensitivity)
feedback divider chain, output mux, retiming flop; shares VSS
shared ground for every domain except the VCO (which has its own GND_VCO)

netlist.provenance: schematic (design/pll_top.sch, exported by design/netlist.sh, checked for staleness by design/netlist.sh --check)
netlist.note: Schematic-level only — no extracted (post-layout) netlist exists for the assembled block. design/README.md documents the two-block netlist-export convention this repo uses.

layout.top_cell_status: No pll_top-level (placed-and-routed) layout exists. Each non-passive sub-block below has its own independent, DRC/LVS-clean transistor-level layout; the loop filter (passive-only) has no drawn layout; nothing has been assembled into one pll_top physical view, and no PLL block has been fabricated or measured (README.md Status).
layout.floorplan_skeleton_note: A block-placement GDS skeleton (issue #17) that exercises the DRC flow end to end — placement rectangles and keep-outs, not device-level geometry for any block.

sub_blocks.name: loop_filter
sub_blocks.note: Passive-only (R + C1 + C2). No drawn layout exists; its area entry below is a device-data calculation (DR-006), not a GDS measurement.

ports.name: REF
ports.meaning: reference clock input, CMOS square wave (spec/pll.md#reference-input)

ports.name: B0
ports.meaning: VCO band select, bit 0 of 3 (band-selection rule, spec/pll.md#band-selection-rule)

ports.name: CPB0
ports.meaning: charge-pump current trim, bit 0 of 2 (Icp trim-code rule, spec/pll.md#icp-trim-code-rule); named CPB* rather than B* only to keep net names distinct from the VCO band bits

ports.name: LDT0
ports.meaning: lock-detector window trim, bit 0 of 4 — a static process trim set once at test, not an application choice (Lock-detector window trim-code rule, spec/pll.md#lock-detector-window-trim-code-rule)

ports.name: P0
ports.meaning: divider modulus control, bit 0 of 6; N = 2^k + sum(P_j * 2^j, j<k) (spec/pll.md#multiplication-ratio)

ports.name: SEL0
ports.meaning: divider chain-length select, one-hot, bit 0 of 6 (SEL_(k-1)=1 terminates the modulus chain at N's own length)

ports.name: IBN
ports.meaning: charge-pump bias current reference (n-side); bias generation is out of scope for this block — driven ideally at 4x the unit-leg current in every sim/ testbench

ports.name: CLK
ports.meaning: the block's output clock, rail-to-rail CMOS on VDD_VCO (spec/pll.md#output-levels-and-drive)

ports.name: DIVOUT
ports.meaning: monitor only: pre-retiming divider/mux output, delay moves with the programmed N — not the feedback edge the PFD sees

ports.name: FB
ports.meaning: monitor + PFD feedback: the retiming flop's output, one VCO-clocked clk→Q after the divider edge, independent of N

ports.name: LOCK
ports.meaning: digital lock-status flag from the phase-error window comparator (spec/pll.md#lock-detector)

ports.name: VCTRL
ports.meaning: the loop filter's control node; brought out for observability, not an external control input

ports.name: GND_VCO
ports.meaning: VCO domain ground (the VCO's own, separate from VSS)

ports.name: VSS
ports.meaning: shared ground for every domain except the VCO

port_list_source: design/netlist/pll_top.spice (.subckt pll_top line + *.ipin/*.opin/*.iopin annotations), cross-checked against design/README.md#pins

area.note: No pll_top-level (placed-and-routed) area exists — there is no top cell to measure. Each of the four non-passive sub-blocks below has an independently measured, DRC/LVS-clean drawn bounding-box area; the loop filter (passive-only) has no drawn layout and its figure is a device-data calculation (DR-006, x1.15 for bulk taps + interconnect on top of the devices' own body-tie/guard). Summing all five with no placement, routing, or block-to-block guard-ring overhead already exceeds the ratified budget below — see layout/floorplan/PLL-FLOORPLAN.md §5.9 for the current, actively-revised whole-chip accounting (this is fast-moving work; re-derive from that section rather than trusting this snapshot to stay current).

loop_filter.source: layout/floorplan/PLL-FLOORPLAN.md §3 (32,118 um2 device sum: R 856 + C1 30,276 + C2 986) x1.15 overhead

area.overhead_factor_note: x1.25 whole-block placement/routing overhead, per layout/floorplan/PLL-FLOORPLAN.md §5

maturity.ladder: simulation-complete -> layout DRC/LVS-clean -> shuttle seat -> measured silicon over temperature (README.md)
maturity.rung: pre-T1 (klayout-tools design-evidence tiers) — 0 of 22 T1 rows met as of the committed tier-report.json
maturity.note: 0/22 is the correct, honestly-graded result today, not a bug — see signoff/README.md 'Why every row is unmet': no evidence envelope is cited into signoff/block-manifest.json yet. Independently of that grading gap, four of the block's five sub-blocks (vco, pfd_cp, divider_chain, lock_detector) already have committed, DRC/LVS-clean, LVS-matched transistor-level layouts and closed-loop schematic-level simulation evidence spans dozens of campaigns (both per README.md's own Status section) — but there is no pll_top-level placed-and-routed layout, so the block as a whole has reached neither the 'simulation-complete' nor the 'layout DRC/LVS-clean' rung of the ladder above as a single, assembled unit.
